scope: Bounded Badok public catalog/player review; title/artist discovery, normal PWA CORS, JSONP and one provider-UI song click. No MP3 URL or song ID hardcoded into the diagnostic.

findings.result: The provider-origin public query Olentzero returns the exact Izaro song/album entry; Epoitaitaye returns zero songs in that valid response. The positive entry carries a data-mp3 marker, not a media URL.
Normal Pages-origin JSON, HTML and WP REST-index requests, plus opaque-frame JSON, fail MissingAllowOriginHeader. Conventional callback JSONP does not call back and is blocked by ORB.

After declining optional cookies in a disposable browser, a normal unobstructed song click changes the hash to the discovered numeric track ID. The player object stays null, its audio element has no source, and no media address/request is observed after5.5seconds. This observation is limited to that UI/session; it does not prove that all Badok recordings are unavailable.
The loaded navigation/player assets inspected do not expose a current MP3-resolution handler for that link. No guessed endpoint enumeration or private backend route was attempted.

unverified: Current full MP3 URL for the candidate
conclusion: Keep Badok as a metadata lead, not a verified audio source. No general pure-PWA audio route was established by this bounded probe.
